about: Live readings that are not live. Every tool that reads Flock's stored crowd readings reads this file (services/labelQuarantine.js): serving drops these readings from the per-venue offset and the nowcast, the export leaves them out, preparation refuses a file that still holds them, and the evaluation scripts never score them. A window is closed on what was found; widening or closing one is a change to this file, with its evidence, in review.

windows.source: BestTime /api/v1/forecasts/live, collected by scripts/ml/collectRealtime.js with venue_live_busyness_available true
evidence: A venue's reading equals its reading at the same hour seven days earlier in 89% to 99% of pairs in every week from 23 October (98.9, 97.0, 93.1, 89.2, 92.3 by week), against 13% to 18% in September and early October.
The reading is 0 wherever the vendor forecast for that hour is 0.
Readings track the vendor forecast with correlation 0.94, against 0.34 before 12 October.
The collector code did not change between 28 September and 27 October, and exports of 8 October, 5 November and 25 November agree on the rows they share.
windows.what_is_not_known: Why the provider's live endpoint answered with forecast-derived values from 23 October 07:09 (provider clock). The raw answers were never stored.
